spans.s:
उज्ज्वल a.
1 Bright, shining,
luminous, splendid; उज्ज्वलकपालं मुखं
Śi. 9. 48, 47.
--2 Burning.
--3 Clean, clear,
white; Śi. 6. 5.
--4 Lovely, beautiful;
सर्गो निसर्गोज्ज्वलः

.
--6
Blown, expanded.
--7 Unrestrained,
full; Śi. 5. 48
--लः Love, passion.
--ला
1 Splendour, brightness.
--2
Clearness.
--3 A form of the Jagatī
metre.
--लं Gold.
--Comp.
--दत्तः N.
of the author of a commentary on
the Uṇādi Sūtras.

1 Burning, shining.
--2
Splendour, brilliance.
--3 Fire.
--4
Gold.

उज्ज्वलित p. p. Lighted, shining,
brilliant.
